import sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')

cmds=[{"op":"load","n":8,"links":[[u,v,c] for u,v,c in links],"bookings":[]},

out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","submission/main.py"],input="\n".join(json.dumps(c) for c in cmds)+"\n",capture_output=True,text=True)
